source.interpretation: System.MAXNC is an optional non-negative integer for the deployed system. At exactly MAXNC noncritical failures, another noncritical failure changes all to critical. Default MissionType.SYACF is Y, so a threshold-triggered critical failure during mission aborts immediately. The total of three subitem FRT values is 9,000,000 and System.FRT is set to the same value as required by manual p255, avoiding residual system direct-repair failures. NCFTL remains unset in both arms, so time tolerance does not trigger escalation.

predeclared_hypotheses_not_outcomes: Three installed identical LRUs with high positive FRT create three distinct noncritical item failures during the first scheduled two-hour mission under the fixed seed.

With MAXNC=2, the first fault is below the threshold and the second reaches but does not exceed it; the third exceeds it, changes the system/failures to critical and aborts the first mission under default SYACF=Y.
With MAXNC=3, the same three noncritical failures merely reach the limit; the first mission completes instead of aborting.

The zero-stock setting leaves any noncritical postreturn replacement tasks waiting; threshold-triggered critical tasks can proceed to physical removal and same-item repair. Exact event times, identity and queue order are native outcomes.
If fewer than three independent faults occur, or native count/abort differs, the threshold claim fails and is not rewritten after the run.
native_acceptance_gates: Source fingerprints and exact parent/arm deltas verified before native execution; the only business difference between arms is deployed System.MAXNC=2 versus3.
Serial session-0 SSH with host-wide mutex, protected GUI PID13340, unchanged installed exe/manual/dictionary and no converter errors.
All authored row-containing tables import/export identically, valid nonempty SXO/event/result output and matched fixed seed/horizon.

Independent read-only replay establishes distinct fault identities and count before/equal/exceeded, criticality conversion, mission disposition, task/stock ledgers, 72-bin System/Stock results and terminal state.
